title: Email accounts
description: Send and receive customer email from the mailboxes you choose.
emptyDescription: Connect a work or personal mailbox to keep conversations with your customers in one place.
chooseDescription: Mailbox access is separate from signing in to Warpdrive.
independentDescription: Connect securely to your own IMAP and SMTP mail server.
gmailDescription: Continue with Google to choose the mailbox and review its permissions.
gmailUnavailable: Google mailbox connection is not configured for this installation.
credentialsDescription: Use the server details provided by your email administrator.
reconnectDescription: Enter fresh credentials for this same mailbox. Existing conversations stay linked to it.
emailHelp: Use the address this mailbox is authorized to send from.
credentialHelp: If your provider requires an app password, use that instead of your account password. Your credentials are encrypted.
noTestSend: Checking the connection does not send an email.
scopeDescription: The connection works. Choose folders and how much history to bring into the CRM.
historyHelp: Import messages from the last 1 to 3,650 days. Existing mailbox messages are not deleted.
historyDefault: The default is the last 90 days. You can change this before connecting.
defaultHelp: You can still choose another connected mailbox when writing an email.
saveSuccess: The mailbox is connected. Initial synchronization will run in the background.
noFolders: No selectable folder was found. Check mailbox access and try again.
folderRequired: Choose at least one folder to sync.
invalidHistory: Enter a whole number between 1 and 3,650 days.
manageDescription: Review connection access and choose how this mailbox is used.
cannotTrash: Remote trash is not available for this mailbox.
disconnectDescription: Stop future synchronization and sending from this mailbox. Existing CRM conversations remain. Messages already accepted by the mail server cannot be recalled.
disconnectManual: For password-based access, removing credentials here does not change the password on your mail server. Revoke it there if needed.
disconnectPending: Provider access removal is still pending. Local access has already been stopped.
disconnectSuccess: The mailbox is disconnected. Existing CRM conversations remain available under their current permissions.

errors.authentication: The username or password was not accepted. Check your credentials and try again.
errors.tls: The secure connection could not be verified. Check the server name, port and certificate with your administrator.
errors.network: The mail server could not be reached. Check the server details and try again.
errors.permission: You do not have permission to manage this mailbox.
errors.duplicate: This mailbox is already connected. Manage the existing connection instead.
errors.invalid_input: Check the email address, server details and required fields.
errors.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.stale_check: This connection check has expired. Check the credentials again before saving.
errors.fresh_auth_required: Confirm your identity in account security, then try again.
errors.unsupported: This mail server does not support the selected operation.
errors.connection_changed: The connection changed while you were working. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.delivery_unknown: The mail server may have accepted the message. Review its status before sending again.
errors.unknown: The connection could not be updated. Please try again.

identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed. Repeat the previous action to continue.
settingsDescription: Manage mailbox connections and choose what synchronizes with your CRM.
sentCopyCrmOnly: CRM copy, no extra server copy
sentCopyAppend: Also save a copy in a Sent folder
sentCopyHelp: The CRM keeps a copy in either mode. Enable a server copy only if your provider does not already save sent email. Check your provider settings; automatic detection is not available.
noSentFolders: No suitable server folder is available. Choose CRM-only copies or check folder access.
sentAccessUnknown: Folder access will be checked before a server copy is added.
invalidSentFolder: Choose a folder that is not known to be read-only.
foldersChanged: Some previously selected folders are no longer available. Review the selection before saving.
skipMessageMissing: {count} messages are no longer on the server
parsingLimits: Limits: {messageLimit} MiB per message, {attachmentLimit} MiB per attachment, {bodyLimit} MiB message body, {headerLimit} KiB headers, up to {attachmentCount} attachments.
